name: Stepper
hint: Click, or press and hold + to accelerate.
description: Increment/decrement with odometer digits. Press-and-hold repeats and accelerates; bounds disable the button. The value is a spinbutton (arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End) with a hidden input that carries it in a form.
usage: Use for small bounded quantities (guests, seats, items in cart). Give it `label` (or `aria-label`, or `hideLabel` to keep the name but not show it), `min`/`max`/`step`, then `value` + `onChange` (controlled) or `defaultValue`. Set `name` to submit it in a <form>; `error` shows a message you already have. For large ranges or exact numbers people type, use a text field with inputMode="numeric".

keyboard.does: Moves to the value; the − and + buttons are skipped, because the arrow keys do their job.
Adds or takes away ten steps, stopping at max or min.

screenReader: A spinbutton named by `label` (or `aria-label`; `hideLabel` keeps the name without showing it) that says its value, with `unit` after it, and the new value as it changes. The − and + buttons are named by `decrementLabel` and `incrementLabel` ("Decrease …" / "Increase …" by default); a press on one while focus is elsewhere is spoken through a polite status line. With `error` it is marked invalid and the message is read as its description.

dataProps.description: Controlled value. Pass it with onChange and the stepper shows exactly this (clamped to min–max). Leave undefined to let it keep its own.
Starting value when uncontrolled (clamped to min–max); also what a form reset returns to.
(value: number) => void, on every step, key press, held repeat and form reset.
Form field name; a hidden input submits the current value.
Base id; the spinbutton gets `${id}v`, the label `${id}l`.
Keep `label` as the accessible name but hide it visually.
Accessible name of the + button. Defaults to "Increase <label>".
Accessible name of the − button. Defaults to "Decrease <label>".
Shows the value, announced as read-only; buttons and keys do nothing.
An error you already have, shown under the control and announced.
Goes to the spinbutton element, for focus().
Any other attribute (id, aria-*, data-*) goes to the root <div>. className and style are merged with the component's own.

example:
<Stepper
  label={`Quantity, ${item.name}`}
  hideLabel
  name="qty"
  min={1}
  max={6}
  size="sm"
  value={item.qty}
  onChange={(qty) => setQty(item.id, qty)}
/>
